kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. Benchmarks are no-ops until explicitly enabled.

iteration_params.comment: warmup = unmeasured iterations to stabilize cache/JIT. iterations = measured iterations for ops/sec calculation.

benchmark_suites.name: FileIntegrityStore
benchmark_suites.measures: StringHashMap insert + SHA-256 compare + observe() logic

benchmark_suites.name: RegistryWatchQueue
benchmark_suites.measures: Ring buffer enqueue + matchKey() case-insensitive comparison

benchmark_suites.name: FederationCodec
benchmark_suites.measures: Wire format encode (header + payload + CRC32) + decode (validate + parse)

benchmark_suites.name: CrossNodeAggregator
benchmark_suites.measures: Aggregate key computation + HashMap lookup/insert + severity escalation

benchmark_suites.name: FullPipeline
benchmark_suites.description: 4 events through EventPump -> HostTelemetry per iteration
benchmark_suites.measures: End-to-end: mock source -> ingestEvent -> ProcessTracker/FIM/Reg/Socket -> incidents

production_capacity_guide.codec_target: 10000+ ops/sec for federation heartbeat traffic (~8k heartbeats/sec from 100 nodes)
production_capacity_guide.pipeline_target: 500+ ops/sec full pipeline (4 events each = 2000+ events/sec ingestion capacity)
production_capacity_guide.registry_target: 5000+ ops/sec (registry events are bursty; need headroom for mass persistence-key changes)
production_capacity_guide.comment: Targets verified on Linux host. Windows performance may differ due to allocator and syscall overhead.
